list.name: ds_cm
list.label: SCCM Database
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the Configuration Manager site database (CM_<site code>), with a read-only login. Chosen automatically if its name contains "SCCM", "ConfigMgr" or "Configuration Manager"; otherwise pick it here.

title: SCCM - Site Health

panels.description: Site system roles in Warning or Critical status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_SiteSystemSummarizer WHERE Status > 0) AS [Site systems not healthy],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_ComponentSummarizer WHERE TallyInterval = '0001128000100008' AND Status > 0) AS [Components not healthy],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_StatusMessage WHERE Severity = -1073741824 AND Time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AS [Error messages],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_StatusMessage WHERE Severity = -2147483648 AND Time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AS [Warning messages]

panels.title: Warning messages

panels.description: Status messages the site has logged, per hour, in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, Time), 0) AS time,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Severity = -1073741824 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Errors],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Severity = -2147483648 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Warnings]
FROM dbo.v_StatusMessage
WHERE Time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND Severity IN (-1073741824, -2147483648)
GROUP BY DATEADD(hour, DATEDIFF(hour, 0, Time), 0)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Error and warning messages per hour

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Display=\\', s.SiteSystem) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('\"]', s.SiteSystem) > 0
       THEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(s.SiteSystem, CHARINDEX('Display=\\', s.SiteSystem) + 10, CHARINDEX('\"]', s.SiteSystem) - CHARINDEX('Display=\\', s.SiteSystem) - 10))
       ELSE s.SiteSystem END AS [Server],
  REPLACE(s.Role, 'SMS ', '') AS [Role],
  CASE s.Status WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS [Status],
  CASE WHEN s.BytesTotal > 0 THEN CAST(s.PercentFree AS int) END AS [Free %],
  CASE WHEN s.BytesTotal > 0 THEN CAST(s.BytesFree / 1048576.0 AS decimal(10, 1)) END AS [Free GB],
  s.DownSince AS [Down since],
  s.TimeReported AS [Last reported]
FROM dbo.v_SiteSystemSummarizer s
ORDER BY s.Status DESC, 1, 2

panels.description: Which components logged the most error and warning status messages in the selected time range.

defaults.noValue: No errors or warnings in range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 50
  LOWER(MachineName) AS [Server],
  Component AS [Component],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Severity = -1073741824 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Errors],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Severity = -2147483648 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Warnings],
  MAX(Time) AS [Latest]
FROM dbo.v_StatusMessage
WHERE Time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND Severity IN (-1073741824, -2147483648)
GROUP BY LOWER(MachineName), Component
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN Severity = -1073741824 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, SUM(CASE WHEN Severity = -2147483648 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

panels.title: Components with the most errors (time range)

panels.description: Status of each site component over the last 24 hours, worst first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  LOWER(MachineName) AS [Server],
  ComponentName AS [Component],
  CASE Status WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS [Status],
  CASE State WHEN 0 THEN 'Stopped' WHEN 1 THEN 'Started' WHEN 2 THEN 'Paused' WHEN 3 THEN 'Installing' WHEN 4 THEN 'Re-installing' WHEN 5 THEN 'De-installing' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS [State],
  Errors AS [Errors],
  Warnings AS [Warnings],
  Infos AS [Information],
  LastContacted AS [Last contacted],
  LastHeartbeat AS [Last heartbeat]
FROM dbo.v_ComponentSummarizer
WHERE TallyInterval = '0001128000100008'
ORDER BY Status DESC, Errors DESC, Warnings DESC, ComponentName

panels.title: Site components (last 24 hours)

panels.description: The latest error status messages. Look up the message ID in the console under Monitoring, Status Message Queries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 100
  Time AS [Time],
  LOWER(MachineName) AS [Server],
  Component AS [Component],
  MessageID AS [Message ID],
  ModuleName AS [Module],
  Win32Error AS [Win32 error]
FROM dbo.v_StatusMessage
WHERE Severity = -1073741824 AND Time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY Time DESC
